//: Capability manifest for <KpiStrip> (the .pa-kpi-strip container) — svelte-pure-admin. CONTAINER + AUTO-HEADER slice: KpiStrip.svelte is a pa-card SHELL (<div class="pa-card pa-kpi-strip [--no-*] {class}">) with an optional header (titleText/isLive), an auto-generated head-row built from the visible columns, an optional footer (footerText), and a `children` slot for the rows. The DATA ROWS are a SEPARATE component (KpiStripRow) fed through the slot — the dumper passes slot content as plain text, so the per-row __row/__metric/__now/… element classes are the DEFERRED row sub-slice, not mapped here. noPrev/noDelta/noTarget are the three column toggles (isX bools → pa-kpi-strip--no-*); title/live/footer/noHeader toggle structural shell parts.
